scenarios.A: Cloud Run function (gcloud run deploy --function, Scheduler OIDC, Secret Manager → BigQuery MERGE)
scenarios.B: n8n on Cloud Run (B1 delivery tail; B2 — n8n owning the pipeline — retired in pass 3 phase 3)

cloud_function_new_deals/bigquery_schema.role: report_state (+lock_until), new_deals, new_deals_runs (+data_gaps), new_deals_history, deals_raw, labels_raw, new_deals_last_7d — the shared truth every lane reads and writes

cloud_function_new_deals/deploy.sh.role: Step runner (check-env … tables routines secret deploy invoker | dry | enable | run | replay | probe | status | logs); routines = the UDF, view, table function and procedure the function CALLs (pass 3); canonical gcloud run deploy --function; DRYRUN=1 rehearses offline

cloud_function_new_deals/main.py.role: HTTP function (pass 3): watermark window → HubSpot search → land the search in deals_raw / labels_raw (fatal) → CALL new_deals_batch (shape, score, duplicates, MERGE, history, runs row — one transaction) → watermark → payload from the history slice → delivery; dry lands with mode dry and CALLs with mode dry (D1); lease; shape()/hot_score() kept as test oracles; JSON logs
cloud_function_new_deals/main.py.notes: also layers L4 L5 L6 L8 L11 L13 L15 L16; pass 3 phase 1 by a_raw_root.md, phase 3 by .claude/skills/aider-scaffold/assets/recipes/a_hand_off.md

cloud_function_new_deals/n8n_NewDeals_De.role: Original delivery flow (webhook → rows → XLSX → email); seed of workflows/NEW_DEALS_DELIVERY.json

cloud_function_new_deals/README.md.role: Function-level description: idempotency model, payload contract, canonical deploy, gate order

deploy/n8n.role: The n8n deploy unit for the B1 delivery tail: service manifest + Cloud SQL + secrets + import (the B2 scheduler retired in pass 3 phase 3)

deploy/n8n/cloudsql.sh.role: Cloud SQL Postgres 17 db-f1-micro — the durable store n8n needs (SQLite on Cloud Run loses everything)

deploy/n8n/deploy_n8n.sh.role: Render service.yaml and gcloud run services replace (declarative, idempotent)

deploy/n8n/import_workflows.sh.role: Import the workflow JSON through the public REST API; PUT by stable id; credential placeholder remap

deploy/n8n/secrets.sh.role: n8n-encryption-key, n8n-db-password, n8n-webhook-token; SAs n8n-run and n8n-bq (key for the BigQuery credential)
deploy/n8n/secrets.sh.notes: HubSpot token is copied into an n8n credential — the lane's secret divergence

deploy/n8n/service.yaml.role: Knative Service: pinned n8nio/n8n image, Cloud SQL, secrets from Secret Manager, minScale 0 / maxScale 1, concurrency 1, cpu always on, health path /health

docs/diffs.role: Diff ledger: every commit as a .patch + INDEX.md (git diff for every suggestion)

docs/discovery.role: The skeptic-verified discovery reports the recipes and commits cite

docs/architecture.manifest.json.role: Manifest the page renders (tree, lanes cross-tab, counts)

docs/architecture.yaml.role: This file — the annotations behind the tree

docs/architecture_tree.html.role: Interactive tree /f page (offline; published as an artifact)

docs/ARCHITECTURE_TREE.txt.role: tree /f text of the same manifest

docs/EXECUTION_SURFACES.md.role: The record: motions, vocabulary, timeline, what stays open

docs/EXECUTION_SURFACES.xlsx.role: The Excel lane matrix built from the YAML (COUNTIF parity summary identifies the parallel lane)

docs/execution_surfaces.yaml.role: pass-sequence spec: layers L0–L17 × lanes A/B/C with parity words, steps, remediation, equality checks

docs/EXECUTION_SURFACES_L2.xlsx.role: The pass-2 lane workbook built from the YAML (verify OK): 15 layers M0–M14 × N/Q/W, 12 steps, T01–T12, 4 equality checks; steps 1 and 7 are the Parallel rows, the arithmetic layers read Conditional until W is written

docs/execution_surfaces_l2.yaml.role: pass-sequence spec of pass 2: layers M0–M14 × surfaces N (notebook) / Q (BigQuery scheduled MERGE) / W (webhook CDC), 12 steps, T01–T10, 4 equality checks

docs/EXECUTION_SURFACES_TOOLING.xlsx.role: the workbook built from execution_surfaces_tooling.yaml (verify OK: Layers 1/6/5, steps 1/5/5)

docs/execution_surfaces_tooling.yaml.role: pass-sequence spec of the loop itself: surfaces D/C/B, layers U0–U11, steps 1–11, remediation U01–U09 (what this project corrected), equality checks per generated artefact

docs/PASS1_SEQUENCE.md.role: The recipe: deploy.sh steps in order with look commands, the dry-run gate, the branch points (delivery, write-back)

docs/PASS2_L2_TIERS.md.role: Pass 2 design + evidence: what the CRM holds (2026-10-16), the binning spec, the three execution surfaces, the dynamic options (scheduled MERGE, materialized view, webhook CDC), the decisions pending, the sequence

docs/PASS3_RAW_ROOT.md.role: Pass 3 design + decisions (2026-10-21): why the missing node is a run_ts-keyed root and not an orchestrator, the shape of deals_raw / labels_raw, who lands (both lanes), S1–S9 over the root, the three phases, the acceptance SQL; phase 1 implemented

docs/RUNBOOK_CLOUD_SHELL.md.role: The operator's phased Cloud Shell runbook for wisekeybq: values filled in, a check after every phase, the gate, replay as the idempotency check

docs/SCENARIOS.md.role: The three lanes condensed: what each needs, in which order, what it costs, what it cannot do

notebooks.role: The Pass-1 sequence as a Jupyter notebook for a Vertex AI Workbench instance: one cell per deploy.sh step, then the SQL witnessed from Python

notebooks/cloudbq_deploy_and_witness.ipy.role: Cells 3.x run bash deploy.sh <step> in order (the gate stops Run-All); cells 4.x execute the schema, hot_score_v1 + golden vectors, audit tables and the dry payload through the BigQuery client with job metadata

notebooks/l2_deal_tiers.ipynb.role: Pass 2 lane N (the lab, Vertex AI Workbench): CRM snapshot via main.HubSpot, fill rates, distributions, numpy.digitize tiers, calibration by stage-entry dates, RANGE_BUCKET parity per deal on deal_tiers_lab, equality with the gold table, property definition + StackSync mapping

notebooks/README.md.role: How to create the Workbench instance (europe-west6-a), which identity the kernel acts as, what each section evidences

scoring.role: One hot score: the BigQuery UDF is the implementation since pass 3, Python the test oracle, pinned by shared vectors (the JS port retired with B2)

scoring/deal_tiers_v1.constants.json.role: Pass 2 (L2 tiers): edges 0.5/0.75/0.9 as fractions, labels, closed labels, certainty source per pipeline, the deal_tier_v1 property definition, the unusable properties

scoring/hot_score_v1.constants.json.role: Every constant and tier boundary once; main.py is checked against it

scoring/hot_score_v1.sql.role: BigQuery UDF hubspot.hot_score_v1; proven by tests/hot_score_vectors.sql on the first authenticated run

scoring/README.md.role: Which runtime uses which file and how each is verified

sql.role: The compute lane: adapter views, scoring views, transactional weekly script, registration scripts

sql/apply.sh.role: Render ${PROJECT} ${DATASET} ${SYNC_*} and apply every SQL object in dependency order (… → deals_landed_v1 + new_deals_batch_rows → new_deals_batch); DRYRUN=1 renders

sql/audit_tables.sql.role: writeback_log (written by the write-back job); new_deals_history moved to bigquery_schema.sql so deploy.sh tables creates it

sql/backfill_raw.sh.role: One-time landing of the 90-day set per entity with orchestrator = backfill at the cut-over run_ts (RUN_TS env), so the duplicate horizon is full from day one; DRYRUN=1 renders + bq --dry_run

sql/deals_landed_v1.sql.role: Pass 3 S2 + S7: the VIEW deals_landed_v1 (one typed column per landed property, name_key computed once) and the TABLE FUNCTION new_deals_batch_rows(run_ts, entity, orchestrator, window_start) — the pure batch of any run (window, labels, duplicates over the root, hot_score_v1), column order = new_deals; read-only, callable by anyone
sql/deals_landed_v1.sql.notes: reads deals_raw / labels_raw only; the executed check is tests/pass3_batch_vectors.sql

sql/deals_synced_v1.sql.role: Adapter views over the HubSpot → BigQuery sync (SAFE_CAST; names from .env) + pipeline_labels table/views
sql/deals_synced_v1.sql.notes: the sync is scheduled, never real-time: lookback + 36 h freshness guard replace A's exact createdate window

sql/deal_tiers_apply.sql.role: Pass 2 scheduled MERGE: deal_tiers_v1 → deal_tiers (IS DISTINCT FROM, previous_tier, last_changed_at) + history rows for this run's changes; idempotent

sql/deal_tiers_v1.sql.role: Pass 2 lane Q: deal_certainty_v1 (source per pipeline) → deal_tiers_v1 (RANGE_BUCKET ≡ digitize, labels) → deal_tiers gold + deal_tiers_history + deal_tiers_summary_v1

sql/hot_deals_v1.sql.role: hot_deals_v1 (UDF over open scored deals, per-region ROW_NUMBER, global RANK), top-5 by region, write-back delta view (never NULL)

sql/land_raw.sql.role: Pass 3 root for lane C: the 90-day set landed from the SYNC TABLE with HubSpot property names (TO_JSON of 28 of the 29 PROPS — hs_object_source_detail_1 waits for the first transfer, one row per deal) into deals_raw, the labels from the synced views into labels_raw; INSERT first, DELETE-older second; plain DML outside the transaction
sql/land_raw.sql.notes: spliced into new_deals_weekly.sql by scheduled_query.sh and reused by backfill_raw.sh

sql/new_deals_batch.sql.role: Pass 3 S8: the PROCEDURE new_deals_batch(…) — the one write path: lease check, TEMP batch from the table function, dry → one runs row, else ONE transaction MERGE (frozen four, older-slice guard) → history → runs row → report_state (GREATEST) with ROLLBACK + FAILED row on error
sql/new_deals_batch.sql.notes: lane C calls it from phase 2; lane A from phase 3

sql/new_deals_weekly.sql.role: Scheduled script per entity (pass 3 phase 2): freshness guard → land the 90-day set (sql/land_raw.sql spliced at -- @include, inside BEGIN … EXCEPTION → raw_landing_failed) → CALL new_deals_batch(…, advance_state TRUE, NEW_DEALS_<entity>_C, v_gaps); the batch, the MERGE, the audit rows and the state live in the procedure
sql/new_deals_weekly.sql.notes: same target table and frozen columns as A; distinct report_id so A's watermark is never touched; phase 1 by a_raw_root.md, phase 2 by .claude/skills/aider-scaffold/assets/recipes/c_raw_batch.md

sql/refresh_pipeline_labels.sh.role: Loads pipeline/stage labels from GET /crm/v3/pipelines/deals into pipeline_labels (WRITE_TRUNCATE) — an extraction lane C lands into labels_raw

sql/scheduled_query.sh.role: Register/update one scheduled query per entity (SEALSQ every monday 03:53 UTC, ICALPS 04:23 — off the hour, never the same minute; DISABLE_SCHEDULE=1 is the gate); render() splices sql/land_raw.sql at its marker and needs SYNC_DEALS_TABLE
sql/scheduled_query.sh.notes: scheduled queries run on UTC only; 04:00 UTC is always before the 05:30-Zurich write-back and A's 07:00

sql/sync_transfer.sh.role: BigQuery Data Transfer Service HubSpot connector (Preview, free): Deals + Owners daily 02:00 UTC

tests/hot_score_vectors.json.role: 15 golden vectors (every branch of the score)

tests/hot_score_vectors.sql.role: bq query that proves the UDF on the same vectors (ok = TRUE per row)

tests/pass3_batch_vectors.sql.role: The EXECUTED check of phase 2 (dev dataset, credentials): the 15 vectors landed as a deals_raw slice, read through the view and the table function, score and flag compared, slice dropped — every row ok = TRUE

tests/test_deal_tiers.py.role: Constants ↔ SQL equality (edges, labels, source CASE, NULL branch), bisect reference of digitize/RANGE_BUCKET semantics, MERGE idempotency and v_ variables, adapter columns and apply order

tests/test_docs_consistency.py.role: Annotation parity words equal the layer rows of the workbook; every scenario block has a recipe that exists

tests/test_hot_score.py.role: Builds the vectors from main.hot_score, checks constants, emits the SQL check (the JS port was retired with B2, D6)

tests/test_hot_score_sql_duckdb.py.role: SQL UDF == Python on the vectors and 4,000 random deals, executed in DuckDB offline

tests/test_main_offline.py.role: Pass 3 phase 3: contract == schema; dry lands with mode dry, CALLs with mode dry, no sink/state/lease; live lands BEFORE the CALL and advances the watermark AFTER it; the CALL's parameters (window, started_ms, gaps as an ArrayQueryParameter, advance_state FALSE); landing failure fatal and named; CALL failure → lease released, no second FAILED row; 409; event mode; delivery failure amends the runs row; the landing invariants of phase 1; time-boxed jobs

tests/test_notebook.py.role: Notebook valid (nbformat), code cells compile, every deploy.sh step mirrored in order, enable flag-guarded, secret prompted, no outputs committed

tests/test_pass3_sql.py.role: Offline structure of the pass-3 SQL: view types exactly main.PROPS, table-function columns == new_deals in order, MERGE update list excludes the frozen four, no sync view read, procedure contract, data_gaps vocabulary, apply order, vectors SQL current; writes tests/pass3_batch_vectors.sql

tests/test_regen_workflow.py.role: Generator shapes parse (inline, local, remote, reusable); the commit step in a temporary repository (no change, commit + push with trailer, check mode); README index idempotency; diff ledger skips Regenerated-by commits

workflows.role: Generated n8n workflows: B1 delivery tail + errors (never hand-edit; B2 NEW_DEALS_FULL retired in pass 3 phase 3)

workflows/src/build_workflow.py.role: Generates the two n8n JSON files (B1 delivery, errors) from cloud_function_new_deals/n8n_NewDeals_Delivery.json; --check is the pre-push gate; B2 generation retired in pass 3 phase 3

workflows/credentials.map.json.example.role: Credential id remap template for import_workflows.sh

workflows/NEW_DEALS_DELIVERY.json.role: B1: the original delivery flow hardened (Header Auth, zero-row branch, env recipients, respond last) — the delivery tail A posts to

workflows/NEW_DEALS_ERRORS.json.role: Error Trigger → email with workflow, node, execution URL

writeback.role: The only lane that writes to HubSpot: Node 22 Cloud Run job

writeback/bootstrap_property.sh.role: One-time creation of hot_score_v1 / hot_flag_v1 deal properties (GET before POST)
writeback/bootstrap_property.sh.notes: needs a token with crm.schemas.deals.write — the read-only app cannot do this

writeback/deploy_job.sh.role: SAs, grants, job deploy with pinned secret version, Scheduler → jobs.run at 05:30 Europe/Zurich; execute | live sub-commands

writeback/Dockerfile.role: node:22-slim image for gcloud run jobs deploy --source

writeback/index.mjs.role: Read hot_deals_v1_writeback → batch PATCH ×100 → writeback_log; 429/5xx backoff; 207 parsed; WRITEBACK_APPROVE gate; never NULL

.aider.conf.yml.role: aider: auto-commits, attribution, show-diffs, reads CONVENTIONS.md

.aiderignore.role: files aider must never add (secrets, ledger, workbook)

.env.example.role: One settings contract for every lane (PROJECT, REGION, DATASET, FN, SA_NAME, schedules, SYNC_*, N8N_*); scripts refuse placeholders

.gitignore.role: Keeps .env, keys, the n8n SA key folder and the credential/id maps out of git

CONVENTIONS.md.role: Rules every scaffolded block follows (idempotent by construction, gate before live, shared truth in BigQuery, no secrets in git); read by aider on every run

README.md.role: Map of the three lanes, the reading order and the verify-before-push list

UNIVERSAL_WORKFLOW.md.role: Team page for the tooling loop (recipe → apply → verify → commit → ledger → tree → workbook → index → review → replay → push) on its three surfaces: developer shell, CI check, bot commit; per-tool sections, worked example, bootstrap checklist, FAQ
